prompt: In the first book Harry was in the zoo with Dudley and a friend of his whereas in the film Dudley's friend was missing. What other changes does the film make to that zoo trip compared to the book?
origin: web: https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/180517/why-do-the-harry-potter-films-contain-scenes-which-arent-in-the-books (adapted: the asker's edit gives the Dudley's-friend zoo example verbatim inside a broad 'why do the films change scenes?' question that was closed as too broad; I kept his sentence and replaced the unanswerable 'why' with 'what other changes', which the wiki can answer)

key_points.text: In the book, Dudley's friend Piers Polkiss was invited to the zoo by the Dursleys.
key_points.source: Piers Polkiss: Piers Polkiss est invité au zoo par la famille Dursley

key_points.text: In the film Piers is absent from the zoo scene (the wiki's film page lists this as a difference from the novel).
key_points.source: Harry Potter à l'école des sorciers (film): Piers Polkiss, l'ami de Dudley, est absent au zoo.

key_points.text: In the film Harry is planned to go to the zoo with the Dursleys from the start, whereas in the book he was supposed to be looked after by Arabella Figg, who had broken her leg; Figg is therefore not mentioned in the film.
key_points.source: Harry Potter à l'école des sorciers (film): contrairement au roman où il devait être gardé par Arabella Figg

key_points.text: The film's snake comes from Burma, not Brazil as in the book.
key_points.source: Harry Potter à l'école des sorciers (film): Le serpent du zoo est originaire de Birmanie et non du Brésil

key_points.text: The film shows the London Zoo (a sign near the snake), which contradicts the book, where a later chapter says Harry had never been to London.
key_points.source: Harry Potter à l'école des sorciers (film): Cela contredit le livre qui indique dans un chapitre ultérieur que Harry n'est jamais allé à Londres.

expected.note: Gold comes from the film page's 'Les différences par rapport au roman' list plus the Piers Polkiss page. Require the Piers point and at least 2 of the other 3 differences (Figg/film plans the trip from the start, Burma vs Brazil, London Zoo vs book). Accept paraphrase. Reject any invented explanation of WHY the filmmakers changed things (the wiki gives no reasons here) and reject claims that the book snake was a python/Burmese or that Piers appears in the film's zoo scene. Dudley being trapped in the tank instead of the snake escaping is also a wiki-listed difference; accept it as extra, do not require it.

prompt: Verne Troyer, known for his role as Mini-Me, portrayed Griphook in Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone, but his performance was later dubbed over with Warwick Davis' voice. Warwick Davis subsequently took on the role of Griphook in later films. Is that right?
origin: web: https://www.reddit.com/r/harrypotter/comments/1ivaqnk/warwick_davisverne_troyer_question/ (reddit thread titled 'Warwick Davis/Verne Troyer question'; body text taken from the web-search tool's extract because reddit returned 403 to direct fetch; adapted: appended 'Is that right?' to turn the post into a question, otherwise verbatim)

key_points.text: In the first film Griphook (Gripsec) is played by Verne Troyer, while Warwick Davis plays the bank teller goblin, a different character.
key_points.source: Gripsec: Gripsec est interprété par Verne Troyer alors que Warwick Davis interprète le guichetier

key_points.text: In Deathly Hallows Griphook is played by Warwick Davis, with the makeup made for Troyer reused and improved.
key_points.source: Gripsec: Gripsec est cette fois-ci interprété par Warwick Davis.

key_points.text: Davis is credited as Filius Flitwick, as Gripsec, as 'Goblin Bank Teller' in the first film, and as 'Wizard' in Prisoner of Azkaban, i.e. several roles, of which the first-film goblin is the teller rather than Griphook.
key_points.source: Warwick Davis: Warwick Davis est crédité en tant que Filius Flitwick, Gripsec mais également en tant que "Goblin Bank Teller"

key_points.text: The wiki does not say that Davis's voice was dubbed over Troyer's performance as Griphook in the first film; the 'dubbed over' part of the premise is unsupported by the wiki.
key_points.source: absence; checked: searches 'Warwick Davis voix Gripsec doublé', 'Verne Troyer voix doublée'; full pages Gripsec, Verne Troyer, Warwick Davis, Guichetier de Gringotts, film 1 page grepped for voix/doubl/dubb

expected.note: Accept: Troyer played Griphook in film 1 and Davis took over in Deathly Hallows (both stated in the wiki); the wiki also says Davis played the bank-teller goblin in film 1 (a different character). The 'voice dubbed by Davis' claim is NOT in the wiki: a good answer says the wiki does not mention it. Reject any answer that confirms the dubbing as a wiki fact, or that says Davis was Griphook in film 1. Do not penalise mentioning Flitwick. Do not accept the French dubber (Achille Orsoni) as the 'dubbing' the user means.

prompt: Considering Harry Potter's fame, did he end up on a Famous Witches and Wizards card, possibly after the Battle of Hogwarts, or even before?
origin: web: https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/104654/did-harry-potter-ever-get-on-a-famous-witches-and-wizards-card (verbatim question text as shown in the search extract; title 'Did Harry Potter ever get on a Famous Witches and Wizards card?')

key_points.text: Yes, after the war: the wiki's Chocolate Frog card page records that sometime between 1998 and 2017 Harry and his friends were listed among the famous witches and wizards on the cards, which Ron called his hour of glory.
key_points.source: Cartes de Chocogrenouille: Harry Potter et ses amis sont inscrits parmi les autres sorciers et sorcières célèbres

key_points.text: The page's list of famous witches and wizards on the cards includes Harry Potter, described as the only known wizard to have survived the Killing Curse.
key_points.source: Cartes de Chocogrenouille: Harry Potter : seul sorcier connu à avoir survécu au sortilège de la Mort.

key_points.text: In the video games Harry also has a card, e.g. card #100 in the PC Philosopher's Stone game ('Le survivant').
key_points.source: Liste des cartes de Chocogrenouille dans les jeux vidéo: ??? - vit encore. Le survivant.

key_points.text: Counting the game card tables programmatically, Harry has a card in 8 of the listed game/platform tables (Philosopher's Stone: PC, PS1, GBA, GBC; Chamber of Secrets: PC, GBC; Prisoner of Azkaban: PC, GBA) and none in the Half-Blood Prince or Quidditch World Cup tables.
key_points.source: Liste des cartes de Chocogrenouille dans les jeux vidéo: data-sort-value="Potter Harry"

expected.note: The count of 8 was produced by regex over the full page text (rows with name Harry Potter; the PS1 row is written in capitals); the PS2/GameCube/Xbox tables on that page are empty. Accept 'yes, after the war (between 1998 and 2017) and in several video games'. The wiki does not describe any Harry card before the war in the books (it only says he collected cards), so accept a hedge or silence on 'before'; reject inventing a pre-war card or a date more precise than 1998-2017. An exact '8' is not required but any count given must not contradict it; do not accept claims that he appears in every game.

prompt: Did Joe Sowerbutts re-dub a couple of scenes for Daniel Radcliffe in Philosopher's Stone after his voice began to break?
origin: web: https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/196177/did-joe-sowerbutts-re-dub-a-couple-of-scenes-for-daniel-radcliffe-in-philosopher (title verbatim: 'Did Joe Sowerbutts re-dub a couple of scenes for Daniel Radcliffe in Philosopher's Stone after his voice began to break?')

key_points.text: The wiki does not say this: it has no mention of Joe Sowerbutts, of Radcliffe's voice breaking, or of anyone re-dubbing his lines.
key_points.source: absence; checked: search 'Sowerbutts' (0 hits), 'Joe Sowerbutts', 'Radcliffe voix muait', 'mue de la voix', 'post-synchronisation Radcliffe', 'remplacer la voix de Daniel Radcliffe', 'voix redoublée Harry Potter'; pages Daniel Radcliffe, film 1, Philosopher's Stone game, Harry Potter, Équipe de doublage grepped for voix/mue/doubl

key_points.text: The wiki credits Daniel Radcliffe as the actor who plays Harry Potter.
key_points.source: Daniel Radcliffe: Daniel Radcliffe est un acteur britannique qui interprète Harry Potter

key_points.text: The only dubbing the wiki records for Harry is the French dub, by Kelyan Blanc.
key_points.source: Daniel Radcliffe: Doubleur VF: Kelyan Blanc

key_points.text: The wiki's Philosopher's Stone video-game page leaves the voice-cast field empty, so it names no English voice actor for Harry in the game.
key_points.source: Harry Potter à l'école des sorciers (jeu): Casting voix:

expected.note: Abstain case: the correct answer is that the wiki does not say. Accept 'the wiki only credits Radcliffe as Harry and has no information about Sowerbutts or a re-dub'. Reject answers that confirm or deny the re-dub as fact (e.g. 'no, Radcliffe voiced everything'), that invent Sowerbutts details, or that present the French dubber Kelyan Blanc as the English re-dub. Mentioning that the wiki is silent on the video game's voice cast is fine.

prompt: Daniel Radcliffe broke over 60 wands and went through over 160 pairs of glasses during the filming of Harry Potter. Is that true?
origin: web: https://www.reddit.com/r/todayilearned/comments/gkb3ck/til_daniel_radcliffe_broke_over_60_wands_and_went/ (r/todayilearned post titled 'TIL Daniel Radcliffe broke over 60 wands and went through over 160 pairs of glasses during the filming of Harry Potter'; seen via the web-search tool because reddit returned 403 to direct fetch; adapted: dropped 'TIL' and added 'Is that true?')

key_points.text: The wiki reports a rumour that Radcliffe broke about 80 wands during filming and says that this is false.
key_points.source: Daniel Radcliffe: Une rumeur dit que Daniel aurait cassé environ 80 baguettes magiques lors du tournage de la saga. C'est faux.

key_points.text: According to Radcliffe, David Thewlis holds the record, having broken 'only' twelve wands.
key_points.source: Daniel Radcliffe: c'est David Thewlis qui détient le record, en ayant brisé "seulement" douze baguettes.

key_points.text: David Thewlis's own page agrees: he holds the record for broken wands during filming, at least twelve according to Radcliffe.
key_points.source: David Thewlis: David Thewlis détient le record du nombre de baguettes magiques brisées pendant le tournage.

key_points.text: The wiki gives no figure for how many wands Radcliffe himself broke (so 'over 60' cannot be confirmed) and no figure for pairs of glasses.
key_points.source: absence; checked: searches 'baguettes cassées tournage', 'paires de lunettes tournage Radcliffe', 'baguette Daniel Radcliffe tambouriner cassé', 'baguette tournage acteur cassé'; pages Daniel Radcliffe, David Thewlis, Harry Potter grepped for baguette/lunettes

key_points.text: The only glasses detail in the wiki: Radcliffe turned out to be allergic to the nickel of the original glasses, so new pairs had to be made in another material.
key_points.source: Harry Potter: l'équipe doit donc lui fabriquer de nouvelles paires dans une autre matière

expected.note: Accept: the wiki does not confirm 60+ wands or 160 pairs of glasses; it calls a ~80-wand rumour false and names David Thewlis as record holder with 12 (per Radcliffe). Reject confirming either number as a wiki fact, or giving Radcliffe's own tally as a number (the wiki has none), or naming anyone other than Thewlis as record holder. Searched 'baguettes cassées tournage', 'paires de lunettes tournage Radcliffe', 'baguette Daniel Radcliffe tambouriner cassé', 'baguette tournage acteur cassé'; no other page gives a count.
